name: Periyar Wholesale Foods
site_contact: Receiving supervisor at the main gate security desk
gate_procedure: Present the LR and invoice at the main gate; security issues a gate-in slip before unloading.
delivery_window_policy: Delivery windows are strict. Late arrivals require receiving supervisor approval; reattempts must arrive before 16:00 Asia/Kolkata.

name: Kochi Homeware Distributors
site_contact: Warehouse coordinator at the goods entrance intercom
gate_procedure: Use the goods entrance, ring the intercom and show the LR; wait in the marked bay until the coordinator assigns a dock.
delivery_window_policy: Arrivals up to 30 minutes after the booked window may unload if a dock is available. Same-day reattempts are accepted before 17:00 Asia/Kolkata.

name: Malabar Electrical Supplies
site_contact: Stores clerk at the delivery counter beside gate two
gate_procedure: Enter through gate two and obtain a stores clerk signature on the LR before moving to the unloading area.
delivery_window_policy: Delivery is by appointment only, with no late-arrival grace. Reattempts require a new appointment before 14:00 Asia/Kolkata; later requests move to the next working day.
